T-001.Title: Export readAmendmentInstrument from ledger.ts with both counts

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Write tests first in src/gates/core.test.ts. Import readAmendmentInstrument from ./ledger. Cover the derivation cases the spec names for that file: no-op re-approve (two spec permits, same fingerprint) is 0; distinct spec fingerprints A then B is 1; two unnamed unfingerprinted approve permits are 0, and a later named fingerprinted permit on that ledger is still baseline 0; first spec approve plus first plan approve (different fingerprints, different artifact) is 0; three fingerprinted spec permits A, B, A is 2 not 1; chain depth 0 (no predecessor), 1 (one predecessor), and 2 (two-step). Unreadable Decisions (readGateDecisions not state ok) is reRatificationCount 0. Refuse Decisions, apply/archive gates, empty fingerprint, and unnamed-artifact entries do not participate and do not reset the previous fingerprint. Forced permits participate when they carry artifact and fingerprint. Identical fingerprints in a row add 0. Construct ledgers and Replacement pointers by writing XML in a throwaway; do not add a recorded count field to prove the numbers. Planned reds (at most 3, never repeat): signature-kind test-fail, signature-key amendment-instrument-export; signature-kind test-fail, signature-key amendment-revert-is-two. Record the export-absent fail in its own tool round trip before the production edit. Prefer that one fail so the revert key stays unused unless a distinct-minus-one implementation leaves A,B,A at 1.

Then in src/gates/ledger.ts, beside listGateDecisions and applyingApproveDecision, export type AmendmentInstrument with reRatificationCount: number and supersedeChainDepth: number, and export function readAmendmentInstrument(projectRoot, changeId) that returns both. List both names in that file's MODULE_MAP (MAP_MODE EXPORTS). Do not add a new src/*.ts file. Do not add a Decision attribute, event kind, or ledger section; LEDGER_BUNDLE_SECTIONS stays the set Verdicts, Decisions. Do not export applyingApproveDecision. Do not change its body: it still returns forFile[forFile.length - 1] (tip only). classifyApprovedArtifact remains the only production caller of applyingApproveDecision. Do not import replacementChangeIds from grammar; re-read XML in ledger.ts with the three shapes grammar already accepts (child C-* tag, Replacement text, or ReplacementChange text matching ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change). If spec.xml and plan.xml both name a pointer and they differ, spec wins; else spec, else plan.

reRatificationCount: read the Decision list via readGateDecisions. If the list is not state ok, the count is 0. Consider only entries where gate is approve, decision is permit, artifact is spec or plan, and fingerprint is a non-empty string. Group by artifact. Walk each group in list order (ledger write order). The first fingerprinted permit for that artifact is the baseline and counts 0. Each later fingerprinted permit whose fingerprint differs from the previous fingerprinted permit in that group adds 1. Sum spec and plan. This is a transition count, not distinct-set-minus-one: A then B then A is 2, not 1. Do not inherit reRatificationCount along a supersede chain; that number is per bundle.

supersedeChainDepth: reverse-walk Replacement pointers across active/ and archive/. A predecessor of B is a bundle whose spec.xml (else plan.xml, if spec has no pointer) names B via those three shapes. Depth(B) is 0 when B has no predecessor; otherwise 1 + max depth of its predecessors. Guard cycles with a visited set and treat a cycle as depth 0 from the repeated node so the walk terminates. The surviving tip of a two-step chain reports 2. git diff against pre-change src/artifact and the Decision writer in src/gates shows no new recorded field. Exercise the library on throwaway ledgers, not only string matches.
